items.text: Puka Nacua suffered a knee injury on the Rams' final offensive snap vs Washington and will undergo MRI Monday; team does not believe he tore ACL.
items.why: Late-game low hit on rush; walked off; high volume (14/150/1) with Adams already out.
items.implication: Major blow to Rams WR corps and Stafford volume if misses time; monitor MRI for Week 10.
items.opportunity: Increased targets to remaining Rams pass-catchers and Kyren Williams if out.

items.text: George Pickens (hamstring) ruled INACTIVE; projections updated. Went LP-LP-LP in practice.
items.why: Limited all week; Cowboys activated practice squad WR.
items.implication: CeeDee Lamb full target share; Flournoy pivot as WR2.
items.opportunity: Ryan Flournoy every-down role and target spike.

items.text: Giants QB JJ McCarthy suffered hip pointer in win vs Eagles but team confident he will be ready for Thursday Night vs Washington.
items.why: Returned to game; early positive reports from team/Harbaugh.
items.implication: Giants offense continuity for TNF short week; Nabers/others secure.

items.text: In Breece Hall return from quad, he got 19 opportunities vs Braelon Allen 10; Allen outsnapped him 37-27.
items.why: Post-injury return; complementary roles with Allen power early-downs.
items.implication: Hall still RB1/flex but not full monopoly; monitor for expansion.
items.opportunity: Both viable in deeper leagues; Hall receiving edge.

items.text: Justin Herbert will undergo testing on left (non-throwing) middle finger after exiting vs Texans; Harbaugh said it could be a fracture. Herbert expects to play Week 10 and lobbied to stay in.
items.why: Injured stiff-arming rusher; heavily taped; prior similar left-hand issues managed with padding.
items.implication: Non-throwing hand so likely playable with protection; monitor for MNF vs BAL.
items.opportunity: If out, Uiagalelei or backup QB; Ladd McConkey/others volume stable if he plays.

items.text: Patrick Mahomes MRI after elbow injury showed no major issue; strain/sprain to be monitored for pain/swelling but returned to game and checked out OK.
items.why: Threw elbow scare mid-game but returned; MRI clean of major damage.
items.implication: Full go expected Week 10; Chiefs offense intact with Worthy also dinged.

items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson knee injury occurred very late in game (alongside Nacua); watching status.
items.implication: NE backfield uncertainty; Henderson or others if misses.
items.opportunity: TreVeyon Henderson or committee if out.

items.text: Jaylen Waddle (concussion) among Sunday injuries watched; ruled out after early exit vs Panthers.
items.why: Hit on catch attempt; left and did not return; protocol.
items.implication: DEN WR depth thins; Sutton/others volume up short-term; bye upcoming.
items.opportunity: Courtland Sutton and secondary DEN WRs.

items.text: Josh Jacobs (hand) injury watched; fractured finger, unable to return but team hopes he plays through.
items.why: Left early; LaFleur optimistic on playing through with Lloyd also dinged.
items.implication: GB RB depth thin; monitor for Week 10 availability and handcuff value.

items.text: With George Pickens out (shoulder/hamstring), Ryan Flournoy is the obvious pivot and profiles as solid WR2.
items.why: Pickens inactive opens full snaps/targets for Flournoy who already produced as WR3.

items.text: Tightest two-player target concentrations: NYG Nabers+Likely 54.9%; ARI McBride+Wilson 50.7%; DAL Lamb+Pickens 50.6%; DET St.Brown+LaPorta 49.3%; GB Golden+Watson 48.7%. Tee+Chase 47.3%.
items.why: Season-long target share data showing funnel offenses.
items.implication: High floor/ceiling for listed pairs; roster both or the WR1/TE1.
items.opportunity: Stack or prioritize in those offenses.

items.text: Zach Charbonnet out-snapped Jadarian Price 37-24 and out-routed 13-9 in SEA; Holani only 2 snaps.
items.implication: Price handcuff/committee only; Charbonnet preferred ROS if pattern holds.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty 32 snaps vs Mike Washington 17 in trailing script; 24-6 routes, carries split 6-6.
items.why: Clear snap and route dominance even trailing.
items.implication: Jeanty emerging as clear lead back for LV.

items.text: DEN: Jonah Coleman 58 snaps, JK Dobbins 11 (0 other RBs); last two weeks Coleman 37 opp vs Dobbins 12.
items.why: Clear and sustained snap/opportunity lead for Coleman.
